successIndicator.description: An identifier to determine the success of the portal payment. The gateway will return this value in the resultIndicator parameter (appended to the returnUrl) for successful payments only

returnUrl.description: URL where the customer will be redirected after completing or canceling the payment. Must be HTTPS and cannot contain localhost or IP addresses

allowedAttempts.description: The number of attempts the customer is allowed to make before the payment is considered unsuccessful.

timeout.description: The duration (in seconds) available to the payer to make a payment. If the payment is not completed within this time, their browser will be returned to the timeoutURL. If no timeoutURL is specified, it will default to returnUrl. Valid range: 600-1800 seconds.

timeoutUrl.description: The URL to which the payer will be returned if the payment is not completed within the timeout period. Must be a valid absolute URI, and javascript scheme is forbidden.

displayControl.description: Controls the display elements and behavior of the payment interface

billingAddress.description: Controls visibility and editability of billing address fields. Possible values: HIDE (fields are hidden), READ_ONLY (fields are visible but cannot be edited), MANDATORY (fields are visible and can be edited), OPTIONAL (fields are visible and can be edited but are not required)

customerEmail.description: Controls visibility and editability of customer email field

shipping.description: Controls visibility and editability of shipping address fields

cardSecurityCode.description: Controls whether card security code (CVV) input is required

style.description: Style settings for the payment interface to match the merchant’s branding

accentColor.description: Hex color code to make the accent colors match the merchant’s branding

merchant.description: Merchant information that will be displayed during the payment process, including business name, logo, and contact details

name.description: The name of your business for display to the payer on the payment interaction

email.description: The email address of your business for display to the payer during the payment interaction

logo.description: The URL of your business logo for display to the payer during the payment interaction. Must use HTTPS and image should not exceed 140px in height

phone.description: The phone number of your business for display to the payer during the payment interaction
